scope: Offline prospective policy family and retrospective diagnosis on the two now-exposed event room work orders. Keep all attempts including the two stopped at 120 s. No new inference, no hidden truth in any choice. A counterfactual risk projection is never a natural task result.
question: When is it better to leave a currently legal question unasked, acquire an independent source and use its real answer to enable a shared query on the original frame? Target actual RPC count and full delivery by deadline rather than maximum motion overlap.
prior_inputs: Freeze the actual same-photo calibration before the six whole tasks (four successful single calls, two successful paired calls). Travel estimates from the 16 earlier validation-pilot timelines. Use both a known-site median and a leave-site-out direction median across other previously exposed houses; report both. Never insert a truth value or new whole-task time into policy evaluation. Compare sensitivity to per-external-call hazard 0, 1/12 (one timeout in the earlier twelve single-image public comparison calls with another prompt), and 1-(1-1/12)^2 for a two-question send. These are stated sensitivity assumptions, not calibrated timeout estimates for the new prompt. No fitted hazard or tuned threshold.
methods: At every real event, exact deadline-aware conditional planning on the full action space optimizes E[deadline-restricted completion cost]. Also solve the full same-information general model without equivalence, the previous time-only exact policy evaluated under the same hazards, and the upgraded two-dispatch strong conditional planner. Common source capabilities, costs, model capacity, and eligibility. Integrate previous actual field outcomes only for retrospective path scoring after policy expectations and first actions are sealed. Keep binary-factor prior 0.5 independent for expectations. Frozen measured general clocks are proxies for conditional service given a response; failures score the full registered 240 s.
decision: Publish all scenario variants; at h=0 the exact and original optimizer must agree in expected time for trajectories within the deadline. Never claim a better generic optimum. Test whether counting deadline failure exposure can change a legitimate decision and reduce expected restricted task time, independent of merely changing the site clock. Findings guide a different bounded development task; these two houses cannot become independent evidence.
